actions.text: Pressing a sortable header cell calls the sort handler with the column name, plus the column's fixed sort direction if it has one.
Pressing the table options button opens the table options modal; closing the modal hides it.
Changing the select-all checkbox calls the select-all change handler.

rules.text: Horizontal scrolling is on by default; when off, the container does not scroll horizontally.
Select-all is off by default and the select-all cell appears only when select-all is true and an onSelectAllChange handler is provided.
The options column header cell is never sortable.
A header cell is sortable only if the column is marked sortable (default false); non-sortable columns render a plain header cell.
A sortable header's aria-sort is 'none' when not the sorted column, otherwise 'ascending' or 'descending'.
A column is treated as the sorted column when it is sortable and its name equals the sort key.
Translation falls back to the key when no translation exists, and substitutes {tokens} in the text; the appName token is always 'Sonarr'.

shows.text: Renders an HTML table with a header row followed by whatever rows are passed in as children, inside a scroll container.
Shows one header cell per column that is visible; columns that are not visible are omitted.
Each normal header cell shows the column label, calling it first if the label is a function.
A sortable header cell that is the current sort column shows an ascending or descending sort icon according to the sort direction.
When select-all is on and a select-all handler is given, a first header cell with a checkbox labelled 'SelectAll' (translated) is shown.
The select-all checkbox is checked when all are selected, unchecked when all are unselected, and in an indeterminate (null) state otherwise.
For the 'actions' or 'details' column, when a table option change handler is given, the header shows a table options icon button titled 'TableOptions' (translated) instead of a label.
